subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Hexaaquairon(II)（[Fe(H₂O)₆]²⁺）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Square planar
D. Linear
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: Fe (group 8) 8 e; 6 × H₂O (L) 12 e; the 2+ charge removes 2 e: 18 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex has a 2+ charge, so the metal is Fe(II), d⁶; d⁶ + 12 e from the ligands = 18 e. 18 electrons, but high spin: weak-field ligands put electrons in antibonding orbitals.
